turns.question: For candidates who reached the interview stage between 30 September and 4 October 2026, what was the median number of days from their application to the interview stage?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median number of days from application to the interview stage, so I did not compute a figure. The closest metrics are time to hire (days), which averages days from applying to being hired, and candidates in stage, which counts candidates in each hiring stage per day.
